hero.structure: Min-height 100vh, flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden w-full pt-32 pb-16
hero.background: Deep navy-to-purple radial gradient glow fading to solid black at the bottom. The gradient must be applied via a pseudo-element or absolute div positioned behind the content.
elements: Top bar: Location + Live Local Time (left), Status Badge (right, 'OPEN TO WORK').
Centered large wordmark: 'BHAVY AGARWAL' (Clash Display, 900 weight, tracking-tighter, fluid typography text-5xl to text-8xl max).
Subheading: 'Turning Raw Data Into Actionable Business Insights' (muted gray, text-lg to text-xl, mt-4).

Photo Placeholder: A 320x400px (or similar aspect ratio) frame in the center or subtly offset. Use a glassmorphic frame (bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl) with an inner spotlight glow (#E8E4FF glow effect) to suggest where the photo goes.
CTA: Resume download button and scroll indicator.

trust_strip.structure: Horizontal scrolling marquee (use framer-motion or react-fast-marquee).
trust_strip.content: Text 'CERTIFIED IN AI-DRIVEN DATA ANALYTICS' combined with a row of tool logos.
trust_strip.tools: Python, SQL, Power BI, Excel, Scikit-learn, Flask, Tableau. Use react-icons (FaPython, DiSqllite, SiPowerbi, SiMicrosoftexcel, SiScikitlearn, SiFlask, SiTableau).

cards: Summary Text (col-span-12 md:col-span-8): Big typography emphasizing data-driven approach. Large leading, elegant.
Education Card (col-span-12 md:col-span-4): Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College, B.Tech ECE, CGPA 7.5/10, Sep 2023 - May 2027. Styled as a data card.

skills.heading: Numbered Chapter: '04 // SKILLS'

contact.heading: Let's Build Something Data-Driven
contact.form: Name, Email, Message inputs. Style as dark glassmorphic inputs (bg-white/5 border border-white/10 focus:border-[#7C5CFC]).

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for the 'BHAVY AGARWAL' wordmark using framer-motion (initial translateY: 100%, animate to 0 with overflow-hidden wrapper).
motion.scroll_animations: Subtle fade and slide-up (translateY: 40px to 0, opacity: 0 to 1) while scrolling into view using framer-motion's whileInView.
motion.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform for subtle Y-axis parallax on the hero photo placeholder and the radial background glow.
motion.hover_states: Interactive elements must provide feedback. Cards slightly lift and border glows, buttons scale 1.02.

instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on their role.
instructions_to_main_agent.transparency: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Ensure nav has backdrop-blur.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx files exclusively, DO NOT use .tsx. Tailwind classes must be placed in className strings.
instructions_to_main_agent.dependencies: You must install: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, lucide-react, react-icons, clsx, tailwind-merge.
instructions_to_main_agent.design_execution: Keep it strictly dark mode. No light mode toggle needed as the design is explicitly dark/futuristic. Use precise padding and spacing (p-8 to p-16 between sections).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use layered z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties like transition-colors, transition-transform.
Do not center-align app container text globally.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs to maintain premium feel.
Ensure hover states and micro-animations exist for all interactive elements.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls or build stylized CSS placeholder divs.
